# DevOps Platform Challenge

## 🚀 Project Purpose
The **DevOps Platform Challenge** is a containerized Node.js and Express.js backend application built to demonstrate modern DevOps best practices, automated CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) validation, and robust API testing using native Node.js tools.

---

## 🏛️ Architecture
The application follows a lightweight MVC-style architecture using Express.js. It features a stateless API gateway backed by an in-memory task database and a utility calculator module.

```text
               [ Client / Automated Test Runner ]
                              │
                              ▼
                 [ Express.js API Gateway ]
                              │
         ┌────────────────────┼────────────────────┐
         ▼                    ▼                    ▼
   [ Static Routes ]   [ Utility Module ]   [ CRUD Task Manager ]
   • GET /             • calculateTotal()   • GET /tasks
   • GET /health       • GET /total         • POST /tasks
                                            • PATCH /tasks/:id
                                            • DELETE /tasks/:id
